Precision and Durability for Corrosive Fluid Handling

SS (Stainless Steel) Rotary Gear Pump

At Rotozest, we are proud to offer high-quality Stainless Steel (SS) rotary gear pumps that deliver precision, durability, and efficiency across various industrial applications. Our SS rotary gear pumps are engineered with top-grade stainless steel, making them ideal for handling corrosive and sensitive fluids, ensuring long-lasting performance in demanding environments. Whether you are in the chemical industry, food processing, or pharmaceuticals, our stainless steel gear pumps offer the reliability and corrosion resistance you need for efficient fluid transfer.

Request a Quote Download Brochure

What is an SS Rotary Gear Pump?

An SS rotary gear pump is a positive displacement pump that uses the meshing of gears to move fluids from the inlet to the outlet. The stainless steel construction provides superior resistance to corrosion and wear, making these pumps perfect for industries handling aggressive chemicals, food-grade materials, and other sensitive fluids. The pump works by trapping fluid in the cavities between the gear teeth and transferring it smoothly through the system, ensuring steady and reliable flow, even with high-viscosity liquids.

Key Features

Corrosion-Resistant

Our SS rotary gear pumps are crafted from premium-grade stainless steel, offering excellent resistance to corrosion, rust, and chemical reactions.

High-Efficiency Design

Engineered for maximum efficiency, our pumps provide consistent flow rates, smooth operation, and high precision in fluid transfer.

Hygienic and Food-Grade

Stainless steel is a preferred material for industries that require strict hygiene standards. Our SS rotary gear pumps are perfect for food and beverage applications.

Leak-Proof and Safe

Designed with advanced sealing systems, our pumps ensure leak-proof performance, reducing the risk of fluid leakage and contamination.

Versatile Applications

Our SS rotary gear pumps are suitable for a wide variety of fluids, from highly viscous oils to low-viscosity chemicals.

Low-Maintenance Design

Our SS rotary gear pumps feature a compact design that makes them easy to install in tight spaces. Additionally, their robust construction minimizes wear and tear.

Applications

Rotozest’s SS rotary gear pumps are used in a variety of industries that require high-quality, corrosion-resistant pumping solutions:

Chemical Processing

Ideal for handling aggressive chemicals and corrosive fluids with precision and safety.

Pharmaceuticals

Used for transferring sensitive fluids in a hygienic manner, ensuring product integrity and contamination-free processing.

Food and Beverage

Perfect for transferring food-grade liquids, such as oils, syrups, and other viscous substances, maintaining hygiene and smooth flow.

Cosmetics and Personal Care

Commonly used in the production and transfer of lotions, creams, and other personal care products, where hygiene and consistency are critical.

Why Choose Rotozest SS Rotary Gear Pumps?

Superior Durability and Longevity

Crafted from high-quality stainless steel, Rotozest SS Rotary Gear Pumps are built to last.

Precision and High Efficiency

Designed for optimal performance, these pumps provide consistent flow rates, and smooth operation.

Hygienic, Safe, and Reliable

With food-grade stainless steel construction and advanced sealing systems, guarantee safe.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

faq.q: What is an SS rotary gear pump?
faq.a: An SS rotary gear pump is a stainless steel rotary gear pump that uses the meshing of precision gears to transfer fluids efficiently. The rotating gears create a continuous flow by trapping liquid between the gear teeth and pump casing. Built from high-grade stainless steel, this pump provides excellent corrosion resistance, smooth flow, and reliable performance. It is widely used as a rotary gear pump for chemical industry, as well as for handling viscous liquids and food-grade fluids.

faq.q: Why should I choose Rotozest as my SS rotary gear pump manufacturer?
faq.a: As a trusted SS rotary gear pump manufacturer, Rotozest delivers pumps engineered with durable stainless steel construction for long-lasting, leak-proof performance. Our expertise in designing stainless steel rotary gear pumps ensures precision, efficiency, and consistent output. With strict quality control, advanced manufacturing processes, and strong customer support, we provide dependable pumping solutions for demanding industrial applications, including the chemical sector.

faq.q: What are the common applications of a stainless steel rotary gear pump?
faq.a:
A stainless steel rotary gear pump is ideal for industries that require corrosion-resistant and hygienic fluid handling. Common applications include:

  • Chemical processing (rotary gear pump for chemical industry)

  • Pharmaceuticals

  • Food & beverage manufacturing

  • Cosmetics and personal care

  • Petrochemicals

  • Specialty fluids and lubricants

Its durable SS construction ensures safe and contamination-free operation.

faq.q: What types of fluids can an SS rotary gear pump handle?
faq.a:
An SS rotary gear pump can handle a wide range of fluids, including:

  • Viscous oils and lubricants
  • Syrups and molasses
  • Chemical solutions
  • Corrosive liquids
  • Resins and polymers
  • Sensitive fluids requiring hygienic handling

This versatility makes it a preferred stainless steel rotary gear pump for industrial and chemical applications.

faq.q: Can you explain why stainless steel is preferred for gear pumps?
faq.a: Stainless steel is preferred because it offers superior resistance to rust, corrosion, and chemical reactions. This makes a stainless steel rotary gear pump ideal for aggressive fluids and hygienic environments. In the rotary gear pump for chemical industry, stainless steel ensures durability, longer service life, and minimal contamination risks.

faq.q: Do you supply SS rotary gear pumps across India?
faq.a: Yes! We are a reliable SS rotary gear pump manufacturer and supplier in all India, serving customers across North, South, East, and West regions. Our nationwide distribution network ensures timely delivery and consistent product availability.

faq.q: How quickly can I get an SS gear pump from your company?
faq.a: As a leading SS rotary gear pump manufacturer and dealer in India, we focus on quick order processing and efficient logistics. We offer fast delivery across India, depending on stock availability and order specifications.

faq.q: What should I consider when choosing an SS rotary gear pump?
faq.a:
When selecting a stainless steel rotary gear pump, consider:

  • Type and viscosity of fluid
  • Required flow rate
  • Operating pressure
  • Temperature conditions
  • Seal and material compatibility
  • Maintenance accessibility

For applications like the rotary gear pump for chemical industry, proper configuration is essential to ensure optimal performance and long service life.

faq.q: Is installation and maintenance of a stainless steel rotary gear pump difficult?
faq.a: No, stainless steel rotary gear pumps are designed for easy installation and low maintenance. Their compact design, corrosion resistance, and robust construction make them easier to service and less prone to wear compared to many other pump types. This makes them a cost-effective and reliable choice for industrial use.
